description: This code-behind file for the MCQExam.aspx page manages the retrieval of multiple-choice questions from a database, displays them to the user, handles answer submission, and manages a timer for the exam duration. It interacts with session data, updates UI controls like labels and radio button lists, and performs database operations to record exam results.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ exam page, managing question loading, answer processing, timer, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of questions from the database into UI controls and session variables, and sets up the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on selected answers, records it in the database, and navigates to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles expiration (time out).
